title: Lethal Language
description: A plugin where if you say the forbidden letter/word you get killed!
body:
# 🔤 Lethal Language – Speak Wisely, or Pay the Price!

Add a deadly twist to your server’s chat rules with Lethal Language, the ultimate wordplay survival plugin. This innovative plugin enforces silence in the most brutal way possible: say the wrong word, or even a single forbidden letter, and you’re instantly eliminated. It’s linguistic roulette—one slip of the tongue and boom, you're out.

**Note** follow this plugin for updates on new releases!

## 💀 Core Features:

Custom Forbidden Words & Letters Server admins can configure specific words or individual letters that are off-limits. Whether it's random gibberish or strategic sabotage, your rules shape the danger.

Instant Death Mechanic Break the rule, lose your life. The moment a player types a forbidden entry into chat, they’re wiped out—no warnings, no second chances. It’s ruthless and hilarious.

Dynamic Gameplay Enhancer Great for mini-games, hardcore servers, or chaotic roleplay. Add tension to trivia games, create deception-based challenges, or just keep your players guessing what’s safe to say.

Lightweight & Fast Designed to be efficient and non-intrusive, Lethal Language runs smoothly with minimal impact on server performance.

Simple Setup Easy-to-edit config file mean you can start crafting your deadly dictionary in seconds.

## 💬 Commands:

- /forbiddenletter add (letter/word)

- /forbiddenletter remove (letter/word)

- /forbiddenletter list (to see all forbidden letters/words)

- /forbiddenletter clear (to clear all letters/words)

- /forbiddenletter reload (reloads configuration file)

- /fl (add,remove,list,clear,reload)

- /forbidletter (add,remove,list,clear,reload)

## 🛡️ Permissions:

There is one main permission needed for the plugin (besides OP)

```
forbiddenletter.admin
```

## 🎮 Use Case Ideas:

A letter changes daily—players must adapt or face the consequences.

Troll your friends by banning common letters like “e”.

Use it to create high-stakes party games or linguistic survival events.

Use it to create fun Events!
